ga_manager_statement.text: As President and Chief Investment Officer at Empire Life Investments Inc. Paul leads both the equity and fixed income investment teams who collectively manage certain Empire Life segregated funds and the insurance company's general funds.

operating_entities.note: empire.ca has no single 'our companies' or legal-entities page. The hierarchy above is assembled only from empire.ca pages (Ownership, Fast Facts 'Company ownership', site footer 'OUR COMPANY') and the footer of the affiliated manager's site empirelifeinvestments.ca.
